hints.title: Equivalence Relations
hints.text: Similarity is an equivalence relation possessing reflexivity, symmetry, and transitivity.

hints.title: Connected Component Grouping
hints.text: Group words into connected components using a disjoint set data structure based on the similarity pairs.

hints.title: Pairwise Root Comparison
hints.text: First ensure the two sentences have identical lengths. For each index i, verify that sentence1[i] and sentence2[i] either match identically or share the same component representative.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Disjoint-set forest with path compression determining transitive word similarity.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: BFS or DFS on raw graph per word query risks repeated searches across long sentences.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Union-find collapses components in near-linear time using O(W) storage.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use union-find to model the transitive equivalence relation and check equal sentence lengths.
